title: Prosec: P463-M in VP’s wealth unexplained even sans firm assets
summary: MANILA, Philippines —Vice President Sara Z. Duterte must still account for more than P463 million in alleged unexplained wealth even after removing amounts linked to companies associated with her and…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Vice President Sara Z. Duterte must still account for more than P463 million in alleged unexplained wealth even after removing amounts linked to companies associated with her and her husband, Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong, House prosecution spokesman, said on Thursday. In a press briefing, Alonto Adiong said the prosecution’s findings remained substantial even without including the disputed corporate assets and income in its calculations. According to Alonto Adiong, the amount totaled P463,046,459 based on financial documents reviewed by forensic accounting expert Alexander Cabrera.
